subject: Summer Sale Event - Limited Time Offer!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our Summer Sale Event with exclusive discounts on a wide range of products. Don't miss out on this limited time offer to refresh your wardrobe and home decor at unbeatable prices. Visit our store or shop online to explore the latest summer trends and enjoy savings on your favorite items. Hurry, the sale ends soon! Best regards, The Sales Team
